tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Find a tool listed here instead of guessing its name, and get its definition. Query forms: (1) "skill:<name>" — a whole bundle; call list_skills for the names; (2) "select:name1,name2" — exact tools; (3) free text like "cancel run" — ranked against name and description. Non-billable.

findings.detail: Description of "report_bug" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_live_flow_runs" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Fetch run history for a flow directly from Power Automate. Returns { runs, runCount, triggerChecks }: each run has name, status, startTime, endTime, trigger nam…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_live_flow" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Fetch the full native Power Automate flow JSON from the PA API, including the complete flow definition (triggers, actions, parameters, outputs). Returns the raw…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_live_flow_run_error · Private data: report_bug, get_live_flow_runs, resolve_live_parameters · Public sink: trigger_live_flow · Destructive: tool_search, get_live_flow_runs, get_live_flow_run_error, get_live_flow_run_action_outputs, trigger_live_flow, cancel_live_flow_run, resubmit_live_flow_run, update_live_flow, list_live_connections, test_live_connection, delete_live_flow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_live_flow_run_error · Private data: report_bug, get_live_flow_runs, resolve_live_parameters · Public sink: trigger_live_flow · Destructive: tool_search, get_live_flow_runs, get_live_flow_run_error, get_live_flow_run_action_outputs, trigger_live_flow, cancel_live_flow_run, resubmit_live_flow_run, update_live_flow, list_live_connections, test_live_connection, delete_live_flow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
